intended_application: packaging (antifungal), or medical and pharmaceutical uses

process_steps.description: Chitin extraction: deproteinised with NaOH, calcium carbonate removed with HCl, lipids and pigments removed with acetone

source.quote: the first step was deproteinization with 1M NaOH, in the second step calcium carbonate was removed by using 1 M HCl and, in the last step, lipids and pigments were removed by acetone

process_steps.description: Chitin deacetylated in 60% NaOH (1:15 w/v) in an oil bath under nitrogen

source.quote: chitin powder was treated with a NaOH solution (60% w/v) using a CH: NaOH ratio of 1:15 w/v at 130 °C in an oil bath for 4 h under N2 atmosphere
The obtained CS was filtered and washed

process_steps.description: Chitosan dried in an oven overnight

source.quote: it was dried in an oven at 106 °C overnight

process_steps.description: Microwave-assisted acid hydrolysis in 1 M HCl at 79.08 W

source.quote: acid hydrolysis using the microwave-assisted technique (Discover system, CEM, Matthews, NC, USA) under the following conditions: 1 M of HCl for 29.08 min at 79.08 W

process_steps.description: Essential oil fractionated into deterpenated fractions by reduced pressure steam distillation

source.quote: The essential oil (EO) and the 3 deterpenated fractions (F1, F2 and F3) of Origanum majorana L. (OM) were extracted by reduced pressure steam distillation as a function of boiling temperature

process_steps.description: Chitosan dissolved in acetic acid overnight with stirring, then filtered

source.quote: CS (1% w/v) was dissolved in acetic acid solution (1% v/v) overnight with stirring, and the solution was then filtered to remove potential impurities

process_steps.description: Glycerol added and mixed at 14,600 rpm at room temperature

source.quote: 0.16% v/v glycerol (CS-based) was added to chitosan solution as a plasticizer and the mixture was stirred for 5 min at 14,600 rpm at room temperature
Tween 20 (0.016% v/v, CS-based) was added as an emulsifier to assist essential oil dispersion in the film-forming solutions

process_steps.description: Oil fraction added and mixed at 14,600 rpm

source.quote: oil fractions (0.25% v/v F1, F2 and F3, CS-based) and essential oil (0.25% v/v OM, CS-based) were added and mixed at 14,600 rpm for 10 min

process_steps.description: β-chitin nanofibers added and mixed at 14,600 rpm

source.quote: β-CHNF (0.5% w/v, CS-based) was added to each solution and mixed for 10 min at 14,600 rpm

process_steps.description: Suspension degassed to remove air bubbles

source.quote: All suspensions were degassed to remove the air bubbles
The films were prepared by the casting method overnight at 30 °C using 50-mm diameter Petri dishes
The films were prepared by the casting method overnight at 30 °C using 50-mm diameter Petri dishes
